scope: Synthetic environment filtering for isolated child processes
finding: CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD was removed from every isolated child even though the ClickHouse outbox worker needs it to deliver projections. Other isolated workers had no reason to receive it.
change: Allow CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD only when the isolated worker key is clickhouse_outbox. Preserve the existing ClickHouse configuration for non-isolated supervisors and continue filtering the password from other isolated workers.

coverage: clickhouse_outbox receives its synthetic sink password and dedicated database URL
weather worker does not receive the synthetic ClickHouse password
unrelated synthetic RPC credentials remain filtered
